title: DF-VERIFY/1 — delivery-receipt/v1 (proof of delivery for agent commerce)
description: A signed, timestamped PROOF-OF-DELIVERY for an x402 pay-per-call purchase: cryptographic evidence of WHAT a paid call returned (result_sha256) and WHEN. It is the fulfillment half of an autonomous agent transaction and is designed to complement Google's Agent Payments Protocol (AP2): an AP2 Payment/Checkout Mandate proves the agent was AUTHORIZED to pay; this delivery-receipt proves what the merchant actually delivered. Same tamper-evident, cryptographically-signed verifiable-credential model, on the seller/fulfillment side. The detached Ed25519 signature covers the whole object except its `signature` field, canonicalized json-sorted-compact (see https://dynamicfeed.ai/standard). Zero-PII: the payer wallet is hashed, never stored raw.

profile.description: the fulfillment profile this credential implements

proves.description: this credential proves DELIVERY/fulfillment, not payment authorization

issuer.description: domain of the signing merchant/issuer, e.g. dynamicfeed.ai

resource.description: the paid endpoint that was delivered

args_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonicalized request args (what was asked for)

result_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonicalized delivered result (what was returned) — binds the exact bytes delivered

settlement.description: on-chain settlement facts (the merchant never custodies funds — the x402 facilitator settles)

payer_sha256.description: sha256 of the payer wallet (zero-PII; never the raw address)

verify.description: where to fetch the public key to verify the signature
